title: Flow descriptor
description: One entry from GET /api/bridge/flows. Enough to invoke a flow and to render a picker, without shipping the whole graph.

revision.description: Bumps on every saved edit. A run pins the revision it executed so history stays interpretable after the flow changes.

items.description: Dotted capability id. `oaiy.*` is reserved for the platform; products and plugins own their own namespace (`connector.aokie.*`).

capabilities.description: What this flow needs. A caller can check its grants before offering the flow at all.

items.description: Where execution happens. A capability is offered by a runtime, not by the platform in the abstract.

runtimes.description: Runtimes able to execute it. A flow touching the filesystem is desktop/cli only, and saying so up front beats failing at the node.
